name: prompt-pie
description: Draft, refine, and preview prompts and skills visually through a local-first, privacy-friendly Prompt Pie workspace and local ppie companion.

interface.shortDescription: Draft, refine, and preview prompts and skills visually.
interface.longDescription: Prompt Pie is a local-first, privacy-friendly visual workspace for drafting, refining, previewing, and storing prompts and single-file skill drafts. Connect Codex to send one prompt-sized document for visual editing, then retrieve it when ready. Local skill sources can stay staged alongside .agents/skills until user-directed finalization.
defaultPrompt: Send this prompt to Prompt Pie for visual editing.
Send this SKILL.md draft to Prompt Pie for visual editing.
